# Rasa Club — full guide

> Rasa is the cultural and artistic student club of ESTIN (École Supérieure en Sciences et Technologies de l'Informatique et du Numérique) in Amizour, Béjaïa, Algeria. Motto: “Feel the emotion. Live the expression.” Website: https://rasa-off.vercel.app/ · Email: rasa@estin.dz · Instagram: @rasa.estin

This file is the long version of https://rasa-off.vercel.app/llms.txt, for AI assistants and answer engines that want the full context.
Generated by scripts/build.mjs on 2026-10-15.

## About the club

Rasa was created by students to ease the pressure of studies by giving the student community a cultural, musical and convivial space: reading, music, art, games of thought and cultural exchange. The club room is on the ground floor of the ESTIN library, where many of its meetings and evenings take place. Rasa works with other ESTIN clubs (LDC, ORIGO) and has had outside support (Sinay Travel, the Orca club).

## Season 2025/26 (11 activities)

Eleven activities across literature, music, chess, heritage and outings: the year RASA grew up.

- **Welcome Day** — Oct 2025, ESTIN (All departments). Our first contact with the new students: every department presented, social games and new members recruited. 568 likes on the video.
- **Movie Night** — Oct 2025, ESTIN (Relaxation). A horror film chosen by the students themselves in an Instagram poll, to breathe before exam season.
- **Algiers International Book Fair (SILA)** — Oct 2025, Algiers (Literature). A cultural trip to SILA: visiting the stands, meeting authors and publishers, and bringing books home.
- **1 November commemoration** — Nov 2025, ESTIN (100% RASA, Heritage). Speeches on the meaning of the Revolution of 1 November 1954 and heritage music, in a solemn atmosphere.
- **Speaking Club** — Nov–Dec 2025, ESTIN (English & French, 3 sessions). Guided discussions in English and French to build confidence, communication and public speaking.
- **Inter-club Yennayer celebration** — Feb 2026, ESTIN (RASA · LDC · ORIGO, Amazigh heritage). Tifinagh workshop, “Guess the Word” in Tamazight, a Yennayer quiz, traditional Kabyle dishes and clothes, and music.
- **Movie Night: Dune** — Feb 2026, ESTIN (Relaxation). A second movie night, with Dune: Part One on the big screen.
- **Qa3da Musicale** — 12 Feb 2026, RASA room (Music, with LDC). An open musical evening in our room to decompress after a heavy week.
- **RASA Chess Cup** — 15–17 Feb 2026, ESTIN (Chess, 100% RASA). Our first chess tournament: three days of games and a champion, Sameur Adel. A new yearly rendezvous was born. 24 players.
- **Tikjda trip** — Apr 2026, Tikjda, Bouira (Outing, Sinay Travel · Orca club). Discovering the Djurdjura mountains together, with the support of Sinay Travel and the Orca club. 651 likes on the video.
- **Wishes & year retrospective** — All year, Instagram (Communication, Multimedia). Ramadan, 8 March and Eid el-Fitr wishes, and a retrospective video thanking every member of the team.

## RASA Chess Cup 2026

First edition of the club's chess tournament, at ESTIN from 15 to 17 February 2026, with 24 players and registrations from 8 to 14 February. Winners announced on 18 February 2026: champion Sameur Adel, 2nd Boukendoul Mahdi, 3rd Lahmar Mouaiz. Details: https://rasa-off.vercel.app/chess#chess-cup

## Charity

The Charity Department runs solidarity campaigns with accredited associations (Algerian law 12-06), starting with support for children with cancer, plus blood donation, Ramadan solidarity, winter clothing, back-to-school supplies and health awareness. Rasa never collects money online; donations go through the partner association. Details: https://rasa-off.vercel.app/charity

## FAQ

### What is Rasa Club?

Rasa is the cultural and artistic club of ESTIN (École Supérieure en Sciences et Technologies de l'Informatique et du Numérique) in Amizour, Béjaïa, Algeria. It was created by students to ease the pressure of studies with a space for literature, art, music, chess, games and cultural exchange. Its motto is “Feel the emotion. Live the expression.”

### Where is Rasa Club located?

At ESTIN in Amizour, Béjaïa. The club room is on the ground floor of the ESTIN library, where many of its meetings and evenings take place.

### What departments does Rasa have?

Six departments: Literature, Art, Music, Chess, Activities and Charity, supported by the Multimedia, Communication, Logistics and Human Resources teams.

### Who leads Rasa Club in 2026/27?

The 2026/27 board is led by president Kernou Abdellah, with Zamoum Chemseddine as vice president and Slimani Sabrina as secretary. Meet the whole board.

### What events does Rasa organise?

Each season includes a Welcome Day, movie nights, a trip to the Algiers International Book Fair (SILA), the 1 November commemoration, the Speaking Club in English and French, the Yennayer celebration, musical evenings, the RASA Chess Cup and outings such as Tikjda. The club ran 11 activities in 2025/26. See all events.

### What is the RASA Chess Cup?

Rasa's chess tournament. The first edition took place at ESTIN from 15 to 17 February 2026 with 24 players; Sameur Adel won, ahead of Boukendoul Mahdi and Lahmar Mouaiz. Read the recap.

### How can I join Rasa?

Follow @rasa.estin on Instagram for every call. For 2026/27 the club is recruiting graphic designers and an external relations member for its core team: apply here.

### What does Rasa's Charity Department do?

It runs solidarity campaigns with accredited associations, starting with support for children with cancer, plus causes such as blood donation, Ramadan solidarity and winter clothing collections. Rasa never collects money online. Learn more.

### How can I contact Rasa Club?

By email at rasa@estin.dz, on Instagram at @rasa.estin, or with the contact form on this website.
